answer_1.quote: We specifically target the rapidly growing use case of ambient scribing, where LLMs generate clinical notes from patient-doctor dialogues.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the reward model's ability to select the superior note within the Best-of-N framework using two key metrics: (1) Accuracy of selecting the gold-reference note... (2) Accuracy of selecting the physician-preferred note...

answer_3.quote: We compare our PRM against several strong baselines, including LLM-as-a-judge setups using Gemini Pro 1.0 , Gemini Pro 1.5 ), OpenAI's GPT-4o , o1 , and o3mini.

answer_4.quote: To identify predictors of downstream Best-of-N performance, we conducted a comprehensive reader study involving nine physicians. Each experiment was conducted in a randomized and blinded manner, involving at least three physicians.
answer_4.guideline: Physicians evaluated the top-scoring notes for overall quality and alignment with clinical standards.
